head: Affinity for iPad is out: Canva's free design app with Apple Pencil
dek: Canva launched Affinity for iPad, combining sketching, vector design, photo editing and page layout in one app with Apple Pencil support. The core tools are free for individuals.
details: It uses the same .af file as Affinity on the desktop, so you can switch between kinds of work without exporting. AI features need a Canva premium account. Canva says desktop Affinity got more than seven million sign-ups in its first year.
means: Designers get a full creative app on iPad without paying for the main tools.
todo: Download Affinity from the App Store and sign in with your Canva account to open your desktop files.
